page.layout: One column of full-width text: heading "diß Büchleins." at top, then the list of entries, each printed line on its own line; the catchword "Deß" at the lower right below the last line. No margins.

main_text.l: Ein schöner lehrreicher Ort auß dem Cic. de
offic. verteutschet/ was dem zu handeln ge-
büre/der im Regiment ist: eod. interpr. 156
nuß Keyser Maximiliani I. durch Herrn
Dürern gestellet und gemahlet: auff einem
nischen und Teutschen außlegung unnd er-
deß Autoris, und jrer Majestät danckbar-
ximiliani I. mit derselben May. herrlichen
Porta Triumphalis Carolo V. an seiner May
zu Nürmberg ersten Einzug von einem E[?]

page.notes: Top right corner: a small mark, possibly a page number, not clearly legible; left as illegible. The catchword "Deß" at lower right is read with some doubt. "Ehrn" is printed as such. The reading after "von einem" is uncertain (flourished initial E); marked [?]. "161. & Icqq." is read as "seqq." with doubt, marked [?]. "Keys." (long s) is written as "Keys.". Roman numerals XIIII to XVIII are list entries, kept as printed lines.
